elements.label: Agent config form panel (System Prompt / First Message / LLM / Voice cards)

pattern.description: A virtual camera glides down the agent-config form while pushing in slightly; the LLM field resolves to 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet' with a gradient focus ring as the next fields (Voice, Avatar) rise into view. The 'Build, test, and deploy.' headline stays locked on the left.
pattern.why_premium: Combines a small push-in with a vertical travel so the form reads as being filled step by step; the static headline anchors the frame while the UI side carries motion, and the gradient focus border tells the eye which field just completed.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.to('.form', {y: '-=35%', scale: 1.04, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); at t=0.03 gsap.fromTo('.llm-value', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power1.out'}) and gsap.to('.llm-card', {borderColor gradient on / boxShadow glow, duration: 0.2}); keep the left headline untouched; wrap the form in an overflow-hidden mask.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, -35%], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}) and scale 1 -> 1.04 on the form container; llm value opacity interpolate over 4-5 frames; or spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 120}) without overshoot for the travel.

notes: Camera verdict is push_in but the left headline appears static, so this is a push+scroll on the UI layer only (could also be read as masked_scroll). Cursor rides with the frame and has no candidate box; not listed.
